message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
The table includes the **actual holiday date**, the **day of the week**, whether the holiday was **observed on a different day** (if it fell on a weekend), and the **long‑weekend window** that it created.  

> **Note:**  
> • The list focuses on **federal holidays** that are observed nationwide.  
> • Provincial holidays that create long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, and New Brunswick) are also listed where applicable.  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekend, Canada’s practice is to observe it on the following Monday (unless the holiday is specifically a weekend holiday, such as Canada Day when it falls on a Saturday).  

| Date (2023) | Day | Holiday | Observed On | Long‑Weekend Window | Province(s) Affected |
|-------------|-----|---------|-------------|---------------------|----------------------|
| **Jan 1** (Sun) | Sun | New Year’s Day | Jan 2 (Mon) | Jan 1–2 | All |
| **Feb 20** (Fri) | Fri | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, NB) | Feb 20 | Feb 20–22 | AB, BC, SK, ON, NB |
| **Apr 7** (Fri) | Fri | Good Friday | Apr 7 | Apr 7–9 | All |
| **May 22** (Mon) | Mon | Victoria Day | May 22 | May 20–22 | All |
| **Jul 1** (Sat) | Sat | Canada Day | Jul 3 (Mon) | Jul 1–3 | All |
| **Sep 4** (Mon) | Mon | Labour Day | Sep 4 | Sep 2–4 | All |
| **Oct 9** (Mon) | Mon | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Oct 7–9 | All |
| **Nov 11** (Sat) | Sat | Remembrance Day | Nov 13 (Mon) | Nov 11–13 | All |
| **Dec 25** (Mon) | Mon | Christmas | Dec 25 | Dec 23–25 | All |
| **Dec 26** (Tue) | Tue | Boxing Day | Dec 26 | — | All (no long weekend) |

### Quick Highlights

| Long‑Weekend | Holiday | Dates |
|--------------|---------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day | Jan 1–2 |
| **Family Day** | Family Day (provincial) | Feb 20–22 |
| **Spring** | Good Friday | Apr 7–9 |
| **May** | Victoria Day | May 20–22 |
| **Summer** | Canada Day | Jul 1–3 |
| **Fall** | Labour Day | Sep 2–4 |
| **Fall** | Thanksgiving | Oct 7–9 |
| **Winter** | Remembrance Day | Nov 11–13 |
| **Winter** | Christmas | Dec 23–25 |

These are the only long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada in 2023. If you need the list for a specific province (e.g., Family Day in Manitoba or St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador), let me know and I can add those details.
